name: korean_beauty
archetype: Korean beauty (K-beauty) brand e-commerce and lifestyle site
market: South Korea and global K-beauty audience, predominantly 18-35 women
density: Medium density with generous whitespace and pastel aesthetics. Products displayed in clean grid with lifestyle photography. Each product card has a soft hover animation revealing quick-add button. The visual language is 'cute and clinical' — adorable pastel packaging combined with dermatologist-approved ingredient lists.
nav_style: Transparent-to-white sticky nav on scroll. Left: minimal wordmark logo in script font. Center: navigation links — New, Skincare, Makeup, Body, Sets, About. Right: search icon, wishlist heart icon, cart bag icon. Below nav: a soft pastel banner promoting current skincare routine guide.
commercial_model: Direct-to-consumer brand. Subscription box option. Loyalty points (포인트) system. Free sample with every order. Free shipping over threshold. Skincare routine quiz as lead generation tool.
color_palette: Soft millennial pink (#FFB6C1) as primary accent. Ivory (#FFFFF0) and very light peach (#FFF5EE) for backgrounds. Dusty rose (#C8829A) for text accents and CTAs. Mint green (#B2DFDB) for 'new' badges. Gold (#D4AF37) for premium product markers. The palette is feminine, soft, aspirational.
typography: Mix of Korean (Noto Sans KR) and English (DM Serif Display for headings, Lato for body). Product names displayed in both Korean and English. Ingredient names in small clinical sans-serif. Quotes from reviews in italic serif. Korean brand story text alongside English translation.

pages.title: 홈
pages.description: Full-screen hero with K-beauty model using the product line. Below: new arrivals grid with hover animations. Skincare routine guide section. Bestsellers with review counts. K-beauty philosophy brand story. Instagram feed mosaic.

pages.title: 스킨케어
pages.description: Skincare product grid with skin type filter (oily, dry, combination, sensitive). Cleansers, toners, essences, serums, moisturizers, SPF categories. Product cards with ingredient highlights and skin concern tags.

pages.title: 루틴 빌더
pages.description: 10-step K-beauty routine builder. Each step has a product recommendation. Toggle between AM and PM routine. Add all to cart button. Routine explanation for each step. Quiz CTA to personalize.

pages.title: 브랜드 스토리
pages.description: Brand founding story in Korea. Founder's photo. Lab/manufacturing facility photos. Cruelty-free and vegan certifications. K-beauty philosophy text. Press features: Vogue Korea, Allure, Refinery29.

pages.title: 리뷰
pages.description: Customer reviews page with photo reviews prominent. Filter by skin type and concern. Before/after transformation photos with consent captions. Featured community reviews. Skincare journeys blog section.
